question: Does an eight-seed pilot plan deliver nominal 80% detection for neural-network PPO on fresh training seeds?
planning: Existing observed-gap noncentral-t planner with approximate fixed Welch degrees of freedom; smallest equal count per arm; zero effect/variance and counts above 512 remain visible but are not executed.
confirmation: Independent two-sided Welch test at p < 0.05, report direction reversals and same-variant controls separately; marginal detection, not simultaneous discoveries.
selection: Four different-variant comparisons plus one same-variant control per task. Repeat count is selected from 30,40,50 using cloud throughput and remaining budget before statistical pilots, never from outcome scores.
seed_formula: phase_base + comparison_index*1000000 + repetition*10000 + arm*1000 + index; tasks and comparisons in listed order; arm0/1; index begins0
randomness: Independent root keys and optimizer/training randomness per training seed. Sixteen deterministic evaluation episodes use one fixed task-specific reset set across policies and phases; all inference is conditional on that set.
timeouts: Gymnax default terminal/truncated flags stop GAE bootstrap; no time-limit bootstrap. Fixed environment-step budgets, no qualification stopping or best-checkpoint selection.
summary: Retain all attempts, report all executable different-variant cells and eligibility denominator, per-task and per-comparison detection rates with descriptive Wilson95 intervals; same-variant controls separate. Different variants are not known true alternatives.
source: Adapted MIT control-clock JAX PPO at b090dad8a3b53f937782676c6033ba3557cedfa1, inspired by PureJaxRL Apache-2.0; gymnax0.0.9, JAX0.6.2, Flax0.10.6, Optax0.2.5.
